rollup.description: Posted line rollup preserves duplicate contributions, batch boundaries, missing totals, and separate parent roles.

mapping.filter_criteria: Drive every dispatch in d.load_batch = 'WID_GDSBatchID'. Aggregate dispatch_detail within load_batch = 'WID_GDSBatchID', retaining only status = 'POSTED', by dispatch_no and load_batch; sum quantity * unit_price - discount without deduplicating lines. Left join totals on dispatch_no and load_batch. Left join each Depot role on its canonical code and SHIP SourceSystemID; all Depot batches remain eligible. Missing depots retain dispatches with null role keys; missing totals become 0.
mapping.sample_query: FROM bronze.dispatch AS d LEFT JOIN meta.system AS sys ON sys.SystemCode = 'SHIP'. Group bronze.dispatch_detail by dispatch_no and load_batch to sum quantity * unit_price - discount as net_total. LEFT JOIN totals AS dt on d.dispatch_no and d.load_batch. LEFT JOIN silver.Depot as origin and destination matching SourceDepotCode to the uppercase trimmed origin_code or destination_code respectively, with each parent's SourceSystemID = sys.SystemID.

rollup.generated_sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW temp_dispatch_ship AS
WITH detail_totals AS (
    SELECT dispatch_no, load_batch, SUM(quantity * unit_price - discount) AS net_total
    FROM bronze.dispatch_detail
    WHERE load_batch = 'WID_GDSBatchID' AND status = 'POSTED'
    GROUP BY dispatch_no, load_batch
)
SELECT
    d.dispatch_no AS SourceDispatchNo,
    origin.DepotID AS OriginDepotID,
    destination.DepotID AS DestinationDepotID,
    CAST(COALESCE(dt.net_total, 0) AS STRING) AS ReferenceText,
    CAST(sys.SystemID AS BIGINT) AS SourceSystemID
FROM bronze.dispatch AS d LEFT JOIN meta.system AS sys ON sys.SystemCode = 'SHIP'
LEFT JOIN detail_totals AS dt
    ON dt.dispatch_no = d.dispatch_no AND dt.load_batch = d.load_batch
LEFT JOIN silver.Depot AS origin
    ON origin.SourceDepotCode = UPPER(TRIM(d.origin_code))
    AND origin.SourceSystemID = CAST(sys.SystemID AS BIGINT)
LEFT JOIN silver.Depot AS destination
    ON destination.SourceDepotCode = UPPER(TRIM(d.destination_code))
    AND destination.SourceSystemID = CAST(sys.SystemID AS BIGINT)
WHERE d.load_batch = 'WID_GDSBatchID';

SELECT SourceDispatchNo, OriginDepotID, DestinationDepotID, ReferenceText, SourceSystemID
FROM temp_dispatch_ship;

temporal.description: Two parent roles resolve different half-open SCD validity intervals at their respective event timestamps.

mapping.filter_criteria: Current run batch for the SHIP driving shipments only. Each customer role resolves the version valid at its own event time using [start,end). Keep missing parent matches. Parent versions do not overlap for one CustomerID and System.
mapping.sample_query: SELECT s.ShipmentNumber, ship.CustomerKey AS ShipCustomerKey, bill.CustomerKey AS BillCustomerKey, s.NetAmount, s.SourceSystemID FROM silver.Shipment s LEFT JOIN gold.DimCustomer ship ON ship.CustomerID = s.ShipCustomerID AND ship.SourceSystemID = s.SourceSystemID AND ship.RecordStartTime <= s.ShipTime AND (s.ShipTime < ship.RecordEndTime OR ship.RecordEndTime IS NULL) LEFT JOIN gold.DimCustomer bill ON bill.CustomerID = s.BillCustomerID AND bill.SourceSystemID = s.SourceSystemID AND bill.RecordStartTime <= s.InvoiceTime AND (s.InvoiceTime < bill.RecordEndTime OR bill.RecordEndTime IS NULL) WHERE s.GDSBatchID = wid_GDSBatchID AND s.SourceSystemID = <SHIP System ID>

temporal.generated_sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW temp_fact_shipment_ship AS
SELECT s.ShipmentNumber AS ShipmentNumber, ship.CustomerKey AS ShipCustomerKey, bill.CustomerKey AS BillCustomerKey, s.NetAmount AS NetAmount, sys.SystemID AS SourceSystemID
FROM silver.Shipment AS s LEFT JOIN meta.system AS sys ON sys.SystemCode = 'SHIP'
LEFT JOIN gold.DimCustomer AS ship
 ON ship.CustomerID = s.ShipCustomerID
 AND ship.SourceSystemID = s.SourceSystemID
 AND ship.RecordStartTime <= s.ShipTime
 AND (s.ShipTime < ship.RecordEndTime OR ship.RecordEndTime IS NULL)
LEFT JOIN gold.DimCustomer AS bill
 ON bill.CustomerID = s.BillCustomerID
 AND bill.SourceSystemID = s.SourceSystemID
 AND bill.RecordStartTime <= s.InvoiceTime
 AND (s.InvoiceTime < bill.RecordEndTime OR bill.RecordEndTime IS NULL)
WHERE s.GDSBatchID = 'WID_GDSBatchID' AND s.SourceSystemID = sys.SystemID;

SELECT ShipmentNumber, ShipCustomerKey, BillCustomerKey, NetAmount, SourceSystemID FROM temp_fact_shipment_ship;
